author: Ifmyante
text:
Here's part of a PM I got at the weekend

Anon wrote: Hi If,

may I ask a question? I still find new things to learn here every day. Sometimes I feel overwhelmed by all this stuff. With all what you know now, if you’d recommend one or two strongest concepts, ideas or price situations (I try to avoid using „pattern“, but cannot find a better word) to a noob to acquire first, what would it be?

Certainly there's an awful lot to learn here. But if I were to summarise what I think is most important, I'd say look to an engulf into free space that hasn't yet hit the origin (tg). Very often it will retrace deeply before advancing to the origin

Learn to spot these, and you'll be better equipped than most other traders out there.

I'll be organising a webinar on this very soon, so watch this space:)

author: Ifmyante

Price moves from PAZ to PAZ. The clear target for any trade after an engulf is the other end of the PAZ in that TF If you zoom out to HTFs, you may find the TG is even further, but if not, stick to the TF you're in

author: Ifmyante
text:
No problem

I just want to warn you though that watching candles is an absolute waste of time It distracts you from reading the story of price.

The chart is a page, and a candle is a word. A word in itself has little meaning; it can be taken out of context. Sure, a sentence can be very powerful, as can a group of candles. But to get a real sense of the story, we need to view it all as a whole - be aware of how this paragraph relates to one many chapters back, and get a sense of where the story will lead in the future.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Here's part of a PM I just got:

Hey IF!

You have created one hell of a forum. I have looked the stuff over and am very overwhelmed by the amount that is offered. The only problem is that it seems there are a few different methods at work. Sometimes I see people using supply and demand, others bull flags, and yet others are using caps on price. Is this right, or am I just confused?

Well, what we teach here is the holistic reading of the market. Sure, we give some patterns names, but we're not price pattern traders. We simply get into the mind of the institutional traders. We see their algorithms in action and can read what will in all likelihood happen next.

In essence, we know that if price engulfs South, it wants to move down to the last engulf North. This we teach in 3 easy lessons, and about 180 very difficult ones!

But really, what we do is very simple indeed. It just takes a long time to understand how simple it actually is

author: Ifmyante
text:
I just read the request and went straight to the charts to draw up the answer.

Suddenly an alarm started ringing in my mind, and I was reminded of a chat I had the other day with a couple of my oldest trading friends. I had mentioned a concept, and one of them asked me to explain it. I knew full well that I had explained it before, so was taken aback to be asked about it as if it were a brand new idea. It was an extremely important lesson, and one I thought would've been instinctive to everyone by now.

I got to thinking again that a lesson served up on a silver platter in a free website may indeed have little perceived value

So, before I answer this request, I want you guys to work it out as best you can. In doing it, I want you to consider: Flags/Poles FTR (actualy the same as above) Support/Resistance breaks (I hope you noticed by now that FTR is the precise science of this!) PAZ (Same thing again!)

If you can tie all of these things together with the engulf, you have the unified theory of market dynamics, and you'll be astonished at how simple the market is to read. You'll actually be able to boil it down to; If X, then Y

I do hope you all have a go at doing this - It seems that the best lessons are the ones we work out for ourselves All the info you need to get the answers is already here in the site - so go and put it together

I'll be watching this with interest
